$fixture: operator-authored spawn policy; absent file means spawning is off
profileStatement: Every spawned peer runs as this OS user. Policy and record are accountability, not security: a peer can read every secret this user can read, including the seat key, and can reach a pane below the API. The pane authority CANNOT attribute live input. Read bytes plus a write ledger do not identify an input event, because ordinary application output and untracked input produce identical master bytes; the output-anomaly counter is a heuristic whose false-positive and false-negative rates are controlled-fixture results only, and it is never evidence that a particular input did or did not happen. Enforcement waits on a separate OS user per peer.

denyHarnesses.hermes: no interactive initial-prompt mechanism measured on 0.21.0; one-shot is not a peer

panes.launch: lazy: the pane authority starts on the first spawn or attach, never at serve, so the root CLI takes no startup dependency on the Bun package
panes.absentPackage: spawn and attach exit 1 'pane-package-absent' naming the path and the install line; doctor reports presence, version and whether the authority is running

maxConcurrentNote: an orphan (pid gone, no exit append) holds its slot until an operator runs spawn stop; under repeated SIGKILL this is an operator-reclaimed resource, the deliberate trade against releasing on an unconfirmed death

maxDepthFromForeignSeatNote: an admission allowance, not a clamp: a request whose lineageDepth exceeds it is refused exit 1 depth-exceeds-allowance; recorded lineage is never lowered to fit
